description: Tuning-allowed bilingual purpose/consequence probes for v5 service semantics. This fixture is a development instrument, not independent accuracy evidence and not an unseen holdout.

authoring_policy.source_boundary: Authored only from navigation_catalog_v5_data.py, its first-party source descriptions, and ordinary domain understanding; no holdout fixture or holdout-derived artifact was consulted.
authoring_policy.semantic_composition: Each goal combines a user situation, intended consequence or constraint, and a user-owned final-action boundary.
authoring_policy.alias_pattern_exclusion: No goal contains a complete alias or exact goal pattern from anywhere in the v5 catalog.
authoring_policy.evaluation_use: Failures may be used for resolver tuning, so scores from this fixture must never be reported as independent accuracy.
